d:
Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight-cut bangs. Bright sapphire blue eyes with a confident, commanding expression. Appears to be in late adolescence with a mature, poised air. Slender, graceful build. A futuristic, high-tech white and gold dress with floating mechanical armor pieces and a large, ornate mechanical halo behind the head. Features several floating mechanical drones and a large mechanical rigging system with flight capabilities.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
